text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A clash of the century, truly befitting
the Japan Cup, is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
There is only one thing we want to know!
Which of the two is the strongest Umamusume!?
(Waaaaaahhh--!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be Teio, right?
Sure, it's her first race back in a while, but she's a prodigy.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No way, Mihono Bourbon's gonna show everyone what she's made of.
Don't you remember the Tenno Sho (Spring)?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wanna look, but I don't wanna look~!
I'm getting so nervous~!

In the stands, everyone eagerly awaited
the battle between Tokai Teio and Mihono Bourbon.
Meanwhile, down in the paddock tunnel—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Bourbon! Looking forward to today!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Likewise, Teio-san.
Tokai Teio stares intently at the hand Mihono Bourbon has extended toward her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My injury... has only just healed up, you know?
To be honest, I was feeling pretty anxious too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Watching the 『Tenno Sho (Spring)』 though, it was like...
everything just opened right up for me.”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I already knew about you and researched a ton to beat you, but you made me feel that none of that even matters anymore!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —That I want to race against this Umamusume!
Tokai Teio gripped Mihono Bourbon's hands firmly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I am honored.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nishishi, the pleasure is mine.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you in the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Now, I feel like I understand what Rice-san meant
when she said she 'wanted to catch up.'"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master.
I shall be on my way, then.

And so, the long-awaited Japan Cup
finally gets underway!
